announcement.title: $display_version
announcement.content: Movement routing was consolidated around a fixed player Tween Speed of 200. Portal Fast Travel is evaluated before Bypass TP by route cost, Bypass TP defaults ON, and noclip now follows route/transport lifecycle instead of the presence of a local tween.

changelog.title: $display_version
changelog.content: Unified Movement Routing Engine: removes the retired variable-speed tween path and uses one fixed-speed player tween source (200). Route planning evaluates Sea/Region/Zone, direct travel cost and data-driven portal service metadata; a worthwhile Portal route has priority, otherwise Bypass TP may be used when enabled/allowed, otherwise movement falls back to direct Tween. Portal and Bypass are mutually exclusive within one route decision. Bypass TP defaults ON and UI/runtime share the same session state. Noclip is leased by active route/transport state and is re-asserted after character/root replacement; the follower writes player position only while a local tween is actually active. Portal/Bypass verification is cancellation/revision aware so stale transport results cannot resume an old destination. Sky Lower/Middle/Upper, special regions and all Sea portal candidates use shared topology metadata rather than per-feature routing branches.

changelog.title: Re4Hub v2.0.8
changelog.content: Shared-runtime stability update: fixed stale follower ownership after arrival, refreshed route context across farm phases, rebased bounded server correction from the actual player position, added Bypass TP transport support, event-driven Berry collection, fail-closed ability ownership, capability-driven Mastery skill selection and shared Auto Farm Island.

changelog.title: Re4Hub v2.0.7
changelog.content: Added SkyLower/SkyUpper transition awareness, bounded external-relocation replan and route-hazard handling so map-trigger teleports do not leave stale tween state.
